title: UNCX Network Vesting V2 — shared-pool share-accounting desync; $1.49M incident; residual live extraction $0 (contained by owner-set flat fees)

poc.project: poc/ (Foundry; test/UncxVesting.t.sol; historical replay of the real 48KB attack calldata at block 26,191,744 reproduces the exact post-attack state)

key_facts: Bug: cancel() computes vestedShare = V*D/T and removes D-vestedShare shares without covering already-released shares; release() pays pro-rata of the shared balance. Donations/top-ups skew _shareRatio=(S+1)e18/(B+1) so D/T > S/B and cancels over-reduce global shares; a receiver schedule then over-claims the concentrated pool. Validated integer model reproduces the on-chain EDGEN/ZC legs to the wei.

ETH exploit block 26,191,745 tx 0x35206537...23823d: 11 schedules, 26 top-ups, 11 releases, 6 cancels in 5 tokens; flash-swapped capital from the token's own V2 pair; EDGEN pool 57.34M -> dust; attacker net +107.07M EDGEN of which 57.34M was other holders' funds.
Containment (owner txs, ETH): flatFee 0.05 ETH -> 100 -> 10,000 -> uint256.max (blocks 26,192,030/26,192,977/26,193,348); feePercentage 10 -> 500; token+creator exemptions removed.

BSC: 355 schedules on BTCLE, pool 194,841 BTCLE -> dust, net theft ~$9.2k (DefiLlama BTCLE $0.0472) - not the $969k nominal incident figure; ALL incident schedules are cancelled or fully released (0 live soft+topable; direct scan ids 640-994); _totalTokenShares[BTCLE]=216,115 wei is anomalous but no live claimant was found (monitor future BTCLE deposits).
Base: 13 schedules on IMO; siphon schedule 836 (nominal 10k IMO) released 280,612.6 IMO; net theft ~$111.3k; 0 live manipulable.
Robinhood (26.7KB build): 42 schedules cancelled; attacked RKST pool share-corrupted -> ~$36.5k stuck; untouched AGE/SLEUTH/ASI pools healthy and holder-claimable ($60-118k hard).

Secondary 14.4KB builds (ETH 0xBcD6aee8, BSC 0xEc76C87E, Base 0xcb08b6d8) carry the identical vulnerable math; ETH pool $4.73, BSC $1.34, Base $0.03; flatFee 100 ETH / 100 BNB. Minimum attack cost = 1 flat fee via createAirdropVesting with 3 soft+topable beneficiaries (fork-proven).
Profitability is knife-edge in integer rounding: ~140 parameter combos searched, only the EDGEN-ratio family is solvent+profitable; attackers must simulate and tune.

Monitor: FlatFeeUpdated / FeePercentageUpdated / exemption events on 13 deployments; VestingCreated while fees are high; deposits into share-corrupted pools (BSC BTCLE; ETH EDGEN/ZC/PEPE/LO0P; RH RKST); owner Safe 0x31c44A17... (2-of-N) transactions.

L2 structural finding: on Unichain/Avalanche/Polygon/Arbitrum/OP/Ink no isTopable=true schedule has ever been created (Unichain 1,439 creations -> 0 topable, verified; 12,500+ creations decoded across the six chains -> 0 topable) - the exploit's top-up/cancel cycle is structurally impossible there, independent of the fee containment.

Residual fee exemptions (storage-verified, slot 19): 0x037287a8844835e663c392d7f86eb2dbf2a14a98 and 0x7618283e4d27c1cdca572b791b499e4de9d9954a remain fee-exempt on the AVAX and Arbitrum SECONDARY deployments (mains are clean); their pools are dust ($0.11/$0.50) -> no economic upside today, configuration-hygiene/monitor item.
caveats: Hard-realizable values are bounded by DEX pool depth (25-50% of deepest-pool liquidity assumed); tokens without a DEX pair are $0 hard even with a nominal mark (VEK $2.5M, OXN $337k); AXGT2's $68.6k pool has $0 24h volume (GeckoTerminal-indexed only).
BSC DROPS $1.12M nominal (GoldRush) conflicts with BscScan (~$0) - excluded from H-O; Base DOT $68.5k is a GoldRush mark, liquidity unverified.
Incident-feed loss figures are nominal ($1.49M total); wei-level reconstruction gives ~$242k ETH sweeps, ~$111.3k Base, ~$9.2k BSC (BTCLE price-dependent).
5 Robinhood schedule reads and a few L2 reads hit RPC glitches; symbols/decimals for some RH tokens resolved via Alchemy metadata.
The exploit needs 3 schedules (1 receiver + 2 manipulators) or 1 airdrop call; the donation/top-up capital is flash-swappable from the token's own AMM pair.
A child-agent draft reported 66 live soft+topable BSC schedules; direct on-chain re-scan (ids 640-994) found 0 - corrected in this report.
one_liner: External unprivileged attacker can extract ~$0 live: the immutable share-accounting bug is fully contained by owner-set flat fees (uint256.max / >=$25M equivalents) and zero fee exemptions, all incident schedules are drained, and the secondary 14.4KB builds are code-exploitable but their 100-1000 native flat fee dwarfs their $0.03-$4.73 pools; ~$110-210k of holder value remains (ETH liquidity-bounded + Robinhood healthy pools) plus ~$36.5k stuck in the share-corrupted RKST pool, with re-arm possible via one owner parameter change.
